title: WISDOM Project─XXV. Improving the CO-dynamical supermassive black hole mass measurement in the galaxy NGC 1574 using high spatial resolution ALMA observations
question: What is the SMBH mass of NGC 1574 when high-resolution ALMA CO(2-1) data that spatially resolve the sphere of influence are forward-modelled, and how does it compare with the earlier intermediate-resolution measurement?

data.arrays: 12-m array, plus 7-m ACA for one older track
data.sensitivity: line cube rms 0.15 mJy/beam per 20 km/s channel; continuum rms 11 uJy/beam

what.value: MGE parameters of the stellar light (Table C1)

evidence.quote: are listed in Table C1 of (cite: Ruffa_2023)
derived from the surface brightness fluctuation (SBF) distance modulus reported by (cite: Tonry_2001)

recipe.method: ALMA archive pipeline calibration; concat of five tracks

recipe.goal: Continuum subtraction and line cube imaging
recipe.method: uvcontsub then tclean cube, Briggs robust 1.0, 20 km/s channels, clean to 1.5 sigma

recipe.goal: Moment maps, spectrum, total flux and PVD
recipe.method: masked moments; integrated spectrum; Jörsäter & van Gorkom flux correction using cubes cleaned to 1.5 and 2.0 sigma; PVD along PA 326 deg
key_parameters: moment mask: smoothing 3x beam, Hanning 5 channels, threshold 1 sigma

recipe.goal: Forward-model the data cube to derive M_BH
recipe.method: KinMS forward model of exponential gas disc in circular velocity from MGE stars + point-mass SMBH, linear PA warp, constant sigma_gas; fit with GAStimator MCMC to the full unmasked cube
key_parameters: chain of 2e5 steps, first 1e4 discarded as burn-in; 11 free parameters
assumptions: circular orbits; mass from SMBH and stars only; constant M/L; constant sigma_gas; distance 19.7 Mpc; diagonal covariance

recipe.goal: Assess SoI resolution and scaling relations
recipe.method: compute R_SoI, R_eq via mge_radial_mass, R_min from PVD; compare with M-sigma and M-M* relations of van den Bosch 2016

evidence.quote: We obtain a best-fitting SMBH mass $M_\mathrm{BH}=(6.2\pm1.2)\times10^7$ M$_\odot$
The corrected total flux obtained with this method is $10.1\pm0.1\pm1.0$ Jy  km s$^{-1}$.
an integrated flux density of $2.37\pm0.03\pm0.24$ mJy

evidence.loc: 4.2 Resolving the SMBH sphere of influence
4.2 Resolving the SMBH sphere of influence

score_reason: Data public and recipe largely specified with software and key imaging parameters, but interactive masks, line-free channels and MCMC settings are missing and MGE inputs are in another paper.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, a described imaging and KinMS fitting recipe, and numeric results (M_BH, PA, inclination) that can be checked.
